**Case scenario (Questions 113–114):** A 6-week-old infant has a history of fever for 2 days, and according to the mother, is not feeding well, taking 2–3 breastfeeds in a day. **Case scenario (Questions 115–119):** Mrs. M is a poor, migrant worker who has recently moved into a village along with her husband to work in the local brick kiln. They both will now be staying in this village for a while. The ASHA of that particular village visits her and comes to know that she has missed her last period. The last menstrual period (LMP) was on 6th January, while the ASHA visited her on 4th March of the same year. The lady has never delivered a child or had an abortion earlier. The ASHA talks to her and finds out that her age is 28 years, and measures that her height is 144 cm and weight is 52 kg. A blood test was performed and her hemoglobin was found to be 11.6 g/dL.

Which one among the following test kits available under the National Health Programme can the ASHA use for the confirmation of pregnancy in this case?
